cover_headline: IRS Officer Ekta Vishnoi Wins Three Golds at World Masters Powerlifting in Nevada
facts: IRS officer Ekta Vishnoi won three gold medals at the World Masters Classic and Equipped Powerlifting Championships in Nevada, lifting a combined 362.5 kg in the M2 57 kg category

Her lifts — 130 kg squat, 72.5 kg bench press and 160 kg deadlift — put her ahead of the Canadian lifter on 330 kg and the Japanese lifter on 325 kg, making her the first Indian woman to win Masters-2 gold at the championship
Her coach Sunil Kumar was denied a US visa before the event; Vishnoi competed using his guidance by video call

quote.text: By the conclusion of the squat event, we had already built a decisive 20 kg lead over our closest rival.
quote.speaker: Sunil Kumar

end.headline: IRS Officer Ekta Vishnoi Wins Three Golds at World Masters Powerlifting in Nevada
end.line: Vishnoi, a Joint Secretary in the Department of Biotechnology, took up powerlifting at 45 and within seven years became a world Masters champion.
